title: Liberties House, The Liberties, Dublin 8

prs.tagLine: *** All Bills Included *** Flexible Lease Terms Available

description:
Grayling Property Management are delighted to bring Liberties House to the market. 

This exclusive co-living development boasts the largest selection of amenities in Dublin and is located in the heart of The Liberties - one of Dublin's most vibrant neighbourhoods. 

Comprising 371 high quality studio apartments, this scheme also boasts a range of premium amenities designed to bring people together as well as tailoring to those who enjoy quieter spaces. 

Throughout the building you'll find our friendly, welcoming on-site team who'll be busy looking after your needs and curating events for our residents. 

Amenities featured:
 
Fully equipped gym including classes
Cinema 
24/7 concierge and security
Coworking spaces (private & shared)
Roof Top terrace with panoramic views across the City of Dublin
Yoga Studio
Games room
Resident Lounges
Café
MasterChef style kitchens for hosting friends & family
Chillout corners and outdoor terraces
Parcel handling service

Units ranging in size from 17sqm - 35sqm; contact us today for a viewing to find out which one suits your needs and come experience the vision of modern, sustainable co-living. We look forward to welcoming you to Liberties House and joining our community. 

All bills are included in the rent to make it a seamless and transparent experience. Liberties House is within walking distance to the City Centre and has excellent transport connections, including Luas, local buses, Dublin bike, Bleeperbike and GoCar.
